description_for_model: Interactive views of ServiceNow records and forms. After reading records with the ServiceNow actions, show them with ux__show_records; to collect values for a new or changed record, show ux__show_form. These only display data: every ServiceNow read and write goes through the ServiceNow actions.

functions.name: ux__show_records
functions.description: Show ServiceNow records in an interactive table or detail card. Call it after reading records with a ServiceNow data tool (for example sn__list_records), passing those records unchanged. entity: one of catalog_item, change_request, hr_case, incident, problem, request, requested_item. records: the records as returned (any fields; display_value 'all' or 'true' gives readable values). view: 'list' (default) or 'detail' (exactly one record). total and has_more: paging info from the data tool. The view's own buttons (new, edit, add comment) save to ServiceNow themselves, through the same ServiceNow data tools; don't repeat those changes.

functions.name: ux__show_form
functions.description: Show a create or edit form for a ServiceNow record. entity: one of catalog_item, change_request, hr_case, incident, problem, request, requested_item. mode: 'create' (default) or 'edit'. values: fields to prefill. record: for 'edit', the record as returned by a ServiceNow data tool. Supported for hr_case and incident. The form saves to ServiceNow itself (through the same ServiceNow data tools) when the user submits it, so don't create or change the record yourself.

functions.name: ux__save_record
functions.description: Save a create or edit form from the ServiceNow view. Used by the ServiceNow view's buttons and pickers; not for direct use.

functions.name: ux__add_comment
functions.description: Add a comment to the user's record from the ServiceNow view. Used by the ServiceNow view's buttons and pickers; not for direct use.

functions.name: ux__search_people
functions.description: Find people by name or email for a form field. Used by the ServiceNow view's buttons and pickers; not for direct use.

functions.name: ux__search_hr_services
functions.description: Find HR services by name for a form field. Used by the ServiceNow view's buttons and pickers; not for direct use.

functions.name: ux__get_hr_coes
functions.description: List HR centers of excellence for a form field. Used by the ServiceNow view's buttons and pickers; not for direct use.
